text:
rachel: Idea: 'beaconed followups' for PMs to reduce stale actions. quick sketch here, want quick feedback.

cj: sounds useful. what are the beacons?

rachel: short version: time-boxed checkpoints after an incident. examples: 48-72h quick-check, 14d medium check, 45d deep check. each checkpoint must include a one-liner status + blocker + next-step + ETA.

lee: who gets notified at each beacon?

rachel: 72h -> owner + oncall + incident commander. 14d -> owner + eng manager. 45d -> owner + manager + product. weekly digest -> managers.

nina: how do we prevent ownership ghosts? we've seen owners drop off.

rachel: two mechanisms: 1) ops-bot requires owner to ack within 24h or it escalates to secondary; 2) reassignments for sev1 need secondary ack + manager note.

ops-bot: created reminder job: "beacon:72h:ack-check". if no ack in 24h, it posts @secondary then @oncall-lead.

cj: nice. can we auto-tag repeated incidents as a pattern? currently manual.

rachel: yes. proposal: auto open a "pattern-review" when same signature hits 3x in 60d. pattern-review creates a short sync request and requires a mitigation proposal within 30d.

lee: templates? I like structured fields so we can sort: severity, owner, secondary, reproducible(true/false), risk(1-5), next_eta.

rachel: agreed. ops-bot can emit a JSON-ish row but we'll keep it human-friendly in threads. example 72h note: 
- Status: rolling back fixed config
- Blockers: need approval for schema change
- Next steps & ETA: request approval today, expect deploy tomorrow
- Owner: lee (secondary: nina)

nina: low-friction ack would help. can we use reaction :white_check_mark: to acknowledge?

ops-bot: ack-by-reaction enabled. owner has 24h to react with :white_check_mark: before escalation.

cj: dashboard idea: "Beacon board" with columns by next-beacon date, owner, age, stuck>48h flag, pattern-flag. simple heatmap for risk.

rachel: also add a "cooling" rule for P0s: owner can't transfer without secondary ack + manager note in thread. prevents pass-the-buck.

lee: what about incident commander rotation? if IC leaves, who keeps followups?

rachel: IC is context owner for 72h, but not default remediation owner. recommend service/feature owner take long-term ownership. IC stays as advisory and invited to first checkpoint.

nina: action items:
1) rachel: write pilot doc with fields + examples (due Fri).
2) cj: ops-bot hooks + ack flow (due Mon).
3) lee: dashboard mock (due Wed).
4) nina: pattern-detection rules doc (due next Thu).

ops-bot: pilot scope tag applied: severity >= P1, duration 6 weeks. weekly digest scheduled to #eng-oncall on Mondays.

cj: small ask: make beacon messages include one-click link to open remediation in tracker. reduces friction.

rachel: noted. will include deep link in template.

lee: ok to run pilot?

nina: yes from me.

cj: yep, let's pilot.

rachel: thanks team — will post the doc and ping this thread once published. :thumbsup:
